# requirements-desktop.lock.txt -- every wheel the desktop installer carries (ROAD_TO_10 4.2).
#
# Resolved for Windows and Python 3.14, binary wheels only, with hashes, so two installers built
# a month apart carry the same numpy. requirements.txt leaves transitive versions to pip.
# Regenerate with uv (it resolves for Windows from any machine):
#
#   uv pip compile requirements.txt --python-platform windows --python-version 3.14
#       --only-binary :all: --generate-hashes -o requirements-desktop.lock.txt
#   (one command; wrapped here only for width)
#
# tests/test_desktop_stage.py fails when a pin in requirements.txt and this file disagree, and
# when anything from requirements-laya.txt (torch) turns up here: no local model, 2026-10-04.
